title: Stock cover and status labels
objective: Calculate stock cover in weeks and label each style against two limits.
instructions: For six styles, B holds pairs on hand and C holds average weekly sales. In D2:D7 calculate cover in weeks (on hand divided by weekly sales) rounded to 1 decimal place with ROUND. If weekly sales are 0, use IFERROR to show the text No sales. In E2:E7 show "Check" when D says No sales, "Low" when cover is below the limit in G2, "Overstock" when cover is above the limit in G3, otherwise "OK".
hints: Cover is on hand divided by weekly sales: =B2/C2. Wrap it in ROUND(...,1).
Put the whole thing inside IFERROR(...,"No sales") to catch the zero-sales row.
For the label nest two or three IFs, for example =IF(D2="No sales","Check",IF(D2<$G$2,"Low",IF(...))).
